name: Nest Alpha Vault LP
oneLiner: inALPHA is Nest Credit's NAV-priced dollar vault token, holding private and structured credit positions with nTBILL and liquid stablecoin buffers.
collateral: Diversified portfolio of tokenized RWAs from institutional asset managers plus private-credit and trade-finance positions from accredited protocol partners, with a liquidity buffer of yield-bearing stablecoins and an nTBILL (Nest Treasury) allocation.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base but can appreciate or drift with strategy NAV rather than functioning as a hard 1:1 redeemable stablecoin

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

reserves.name: Nest private and structured credit vaults

notices.title: NAV-style dollar asset
notices.message: inALPHA is tracked because it references a dollar base, but the token behaves like a vault share rather than a pure par stablecoin.

mintAuthority.summary: inALPHA is a Nest Alpha Vault receipt token on a BoringVault-style architecture; depositors stake pUSD to mint vault shares and an Accountant prices them at NAV, while Manager/Solver roles gate share issuance and redemption processing.

controls.label: Nest Alpha Vault minter (BoringVault Teller/Manager)
controls.evidence: Nest vaults use the BoringVault architecture with an Accountant pricing contract; vault receipt tokens (e.g. nALPHA/inALPHA) are minted against deposited pUSD, with manager-gated share issuance rather than free issuer mint.

controls.label: Nest / Plume Foundation vault manager
controls.evidence: Nest is created and managed by the Plume Foundation; manager/curator roles configure vault strategy, gate redemption processing, and hold privileged control over the BoringVault contracts.

review.evidence: Nest Credit docs describe inALPHA as a BoringVault receipt minted when users stake pUSD, priced at NAV by an Accountant; minting is gated by vault manager/solver roles, not a permissionless or single issuer-backend route. Plume enforces sequencer-level AML rather than a tracked-parent wrapper relationship.

sources.label: Nest docs - how to use Nest

unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain BoringVault/Teller/Manager and Accountant addresses and the manager/solver role holders on Ethereum and Plume.
Confirm whether vault share minting is fully open-deposit or restricted to gated counterparties beyond sequencer-level AML screening.
